validation_scope: Length-aware ordered caption display, supplementary CJK characters and bounded live dwell.
Blocked native stop does not block caller; stop/release serialize, cancellation before start and idempotent cleanup.
Actual text translation appears without test-driven scrolling; keyboard/focus dismissal and result attribution remain visible.
Actual external player speech capture, FAST/COMPLETE Chinese subtitles, history originals, pause/resume, resync, model download and offline reload.

prior_failed_validation.resolution: 0.61.0 clears input focus, hides keyboard and brings actual text translation into view; history test scrolls to original text.

limitations: Real user phone and Bluetooth headset not tested.
No measured speech accuracy, speedup or fixed end-to-end latency claim.
Player must permit system AudioPlaybackCapture; first model preparation needs network.
Longer caption dwell can increase queue latency; manual resync skips unfinished speech and waiting captions while preserving completed recent text.
